  emp = c['employees']\n    per_employee = total_sold / max(emp, 1)\n    seller_ratio.append((sid, ratio, total_sold, rev, emp, per_employee, c))\n\nseller_ratio.sort(key=lambda x: (sold/employee) ===\")\nfor sid, ratio, sold, rev, emp, per_emp, c in seller_per_emp[:15]:\n    print(f\"  {sid}: sold/emp={per_emp:.0f}, ratio={ratio:.2f}, sold={sold:.0f}, rev={rev:.0f}, emp={emp}\")\n\n# --- ANALYSIS 4: Companies with suspicious buyer IDs (like 12345679, 12345680) ---\nsuspicious_buyers = {12345679, 12345680, 12345678}\nsellers_to_suspicious = defaultdict(float)\nfor SUSPICIOUS BUYERS ===\")\nfor sid, total in sorted(sellers_to_suspicious.items(), key=lambda x: -x[1])[:15]:\n    c = companies[sid]\n    print(f\"  {sid}: total={total:.0f}, rev={c['revenue']:.0f}, emp={c['employees']}\")\n\n# --- ANALYSIS 5: Invoice amount patterns - round numbers / exact software amounts ---\n# Look for companies with many identical-amount invoices\nseller_invoice_amounts = defaultdict(list)\nfor inv in invoices:\n    sid = inv['seller_id']\n    if sid in all_ids:\n        seller_invoice_amounts[sid].append(round(inv['gross_amount'], 2))\n\n# Find companies with many ~999 amounts (software licenses)\nseller_round_counts = {}\nfor sid, amounts in seller_invoice_amounts.items():\n    round_count = sum(1 for a in amounts if 1000 <= a <= 2000)\n    seller_round_counts[sid] = (round_count, len(amounts), round_count / max(len(amounts), 1))\n\nprint(\"\\n=== COMPANIES WITH MANY ~$1000 SOFTWARE INVOICES ===\")\nfor sid, (rc, total, pct) in rev={c['revenue']:.0f}, emp={c['employees']}\")\n\n# == COMPOSITE SCORING ==\nanomaly_scores = defaultdict(float)\n\n# Normalize Benford deviation (higher = more anomalous)\nmax_benford = max(seller_benford.values()) if seller_benford else 1\nfor sid, dev in seller_benford.items():\n    anomaly_scores[sid] += (dev / max_benford) * 3  # weight 3\n\n# Only-buyers with weak fundamentals\nfor cid, score, c in only_buyer_weak:\n    anomaly_scores[cid] += score * 2  # weight 2\n\n# Outsized sellers (ratio)\nmax_ratio = max((x[1] for x in seller_ratio if x[1] != float('inf')), default=1)\nfor sid, ratio, sold, rev, emp, per_emp, c in seller_ratio:\n    if ratio != float('inf'):\n        anomaly_scores[sid] += min(ratio / max_ratio * 3, 3)  # weight 3,
